title: [KEYLESS + BALL MAGNET + AUTO QB ]
features:
Assisted Throw - fires the real throw remote at the receiver nearest your crosshair

Receiver lead prediction with ping and FPS compensation

Throw power control, 0-95, with optional lock

Auto Hike

Ball Magnet - fires the catch touch, writes no properties

Adjustable magnet range and catch chance (sub-100% so it looks human)

Auto Catch and Auto Swat on the game's own actions

Auto Dive toward a loose ball

Ball trajectory prediction line

Anti Freeze / No Stun - holds you at the game's max legal speed

Anti Jump Cooldown

Block Enhancer - cancels the block slowdown

Player ESP, team coloured, ball carrier highlighted gold

Ball ESP

Live game state HUD - status, playclock, quarter, score, carrier, QB

Admin alert - warns you when a rank-5 admin joins

Mobile friendly, draggable, closing the menu fully unloads the script

Angle Enhancer and Increase Arm Size are included but detected - leave them off
